description: Machine-readable contract for the full-stack portal that powers inventory, order management, and the public storefront API. The portal is one app: staff use the UI; the customer storefront calls the same origin's API routes.

architecture.summary: One deployed app (portal) serves both the admin dashboard and the HTTP API the storefront consumes. Not a separate api.* subdomain unless you add one later as a reverse-proxy alias.

portal.purpose: Inventory, product/department CRUD, order management, fulfilment, payments (Hubtel), customer lookup

storefront.note: Storefront only needs the portal origin. It does not care whether paths are /api/catalog or /catalog as long as paths in this contract match.

architecture.cors: Portal must allow browser requests from www.rajkollections.com for client-side search and auth.

authSplit.staff: Portal admin login (email/password or SSO) — separate from customer phone OTP
authSplit.customers: Phone OTP via /auth/* — used by storefront checkout and account

baseUrl.note: Set on the storefront to the portal origin (no trailing slash). API routes live on the same host as the admin app.

terminology.department: A browse category. Two-level tree: top-level departments (Pantry, Beauty, etc.) and sub-departments (Rice & grains, Body mists, etc.). Products are assigned to a department via departmentId — usually a leaf sub-department.
terminology.collection: NOT USED in the storefront. Do not build a separate collections model unless you want admin-only merchandising later. Navigation and /shop/[category] use departments only.
terminology.product: A sellable item. May be simple (single SKU) or have variants (size, weight, colour, etc.).
terminology.variant: A purchasable SKU under a product. Has its own id, sku, price, stock, and attribute map (e.g. { Size: "M" }).
terminology.tags: String labels on products. Storefront uses "sale" (compareAtPrice > price OR explicit tag) and "new" for promo menus. Filter: GET /catalog/products?sale=1
terminology.keywords: Search synonyms stored on the product. Used by storefront search expansion.
terminology.order: Immutable snapshot created at checkout. Serves as invoice source of truth. PDF is generated client-side from Order JSON.
terminology.trackingNumber: Customer-facing reference format RK-##### (e.g. RK-73262). Public lookup at /track/{number}.
terminology.invoice: No separate invoice entity. invoiceNumber defaults to trackingNumber. paymentReference is the MoMo/Hubtel ref stored on the order.

shipping.note: Storefront computes shipping client-side. API MUST re-validate on POST /orders.

payment.note: Storefront never calls Hubtel. POST /orders creates order and triggers payment server-side.

auth.session: HttpOnly cookie preferred; Bearer token requires storefront wiring

customerProfile.note: Birthday and email are optional and collected after account creation, never during phone OTP sign-up.
customerProfile.dateOfBirth: YYYY-MM-DD date (not timestamptz). Year >= 1900, not in the future. Used later for birthday offers; storefront does not discount from this field.
customerProfile.email: Optional. Store unverified submissions as pendingEmail. Customer.email is verified-only. Confirmation link: https://www.rajkollections.com/verify-email?token=. Token 32+ bytes, hashed at rest, 24h TTL, single use. Unique verified email per customer.
customerProfile.emailResendLimit: 3 per customer per hour and 3 per address per hour

catalog.note: Catalog GET endpoints are fetched with next.revalidate 60 on server components.

images.note: imageUrls are site-relative paths (e.g. /images/products/...). Host serves static files or CDN.

catalogGuide.hierarchy: Two levels maximum in seed data. parentId null = top nav department. Products link to departmentId.

promoMenus.onSale: Products where compareAtPrice > price OR tags includes "sale". Query: ?sale=1
promoMenus.newArrivals: Products sorted by createdAt desc. Query: ?sort=newest
promoMenus.note: Promo mega-menu items are computed in storefront, not stored entities.

variantPatterns.example: Ivory Linen Wrap Dress — S, M, L
Brown Long Grain Rice — fixed 5kg in product.attributes

price.description: Display/sort price. If variants exist, often highest variant price.

inStock.description: Product-level flag. Variant stock also checked at checkout.

attributes.description: Fixed specs when no variants, or shared specs

email.description: Verified email only. Omit until the customer confirms the address.

pendingEmail.description: Submitted address awaiting confirmation. Omit when none.

dateOfBirth.description: Optional calendar date YYYY-MM-DD. Local date, not a timestamp.
Omit to leave unchanged. JSON null clears.

email.description: Starts confirmation when new. JSON null clears verified and pending email.

storefrontBehavior.noParams: Return ALL products + bounds (required for mega menu)
storefrontBehavior.department: Include products in department slug AND all child sub-departments
storefrontBehavior.q: Search with ranking (in-stock boost, popularity boost)

endpoints.responseMustInclude: Every field in schemas.Product — especially compareAtPrice, tags, keywords, popularity, variants

endpoints.note: Session-scoped; customerId not sent from client
Optional dateOfBirth and email. Email is pending until POST /auth/verify-email. Null clears.
Resend confirmation for pendingEmail. Rate limit 3/hour.
No session required. Include customer only when the session matches.

storefrontRequirements.summary: The storefront does NOT call separate endpoints for "new arrivals", "on sale", or "mega menu". It uses a small set of catalog endpoints with query params. The API must return complete Product and Department objects so the storefront can render badges, filters, and navigation without extra round-trips.

usedBy: getMegaMenu() in src/lib/catalog/index.ts — builds department mega menu, On sale menu, and New arrivals menu
layout.tsx — passes mega menu to Navbar on every page
fullCatalogDump.note: Portal must return ALL products in one response (28 in seed; scale with pagination later if needed). Storefront currently expects the full list.

features.apiMustReturn: Full flat array of 18 departments (parentId tree). Sorted by sortOrder.
Products in that department AND all child sub-departments (e.g. department=pantry includes rice-grains, oils, dairy). Mock uses descendantIds().
total count per root department (includes children)
Products sorted by createdAt descending. Top 8 shown.
features.badgeLogic: ProductCard also shows "New" badge when tags includes "new" (4 products in seed)

features.apiMustReturn: Products where compareAtPrice > price. Storefront sale badge uses same rule. Optional: also include tags containing "sale".

features.apiMustReturn: Ranked matches on name, keywords, tags, brand, description, SKU, department names. Search dialog uses /catalog/search; shop page uses listProducts with q.
features.seedIncluded: Each product has keywords[] for synonyms (perfume, rice, shoes, etc.)
